Hogar. Es una persona o grupo de personas, parientes o no, que: ocupan la totalidad o parte de una unidad de vivienda; atienden necesidades básicas con cargo a un presupuesto común y generalmente comparten las comidas (ONU, 1998).

assessments.reasoning: Regarding member_to_member_relationships, Chapter E includes direct pointer variables recording the person order number of each member's mother (Q5A), father (Q5B), and spouse/partner (Q12), establishing member-to-member relationship tracking beyond just relationship to the household head. Regarding extended_ties, Q5 includes options for grandchildren, siblings, parents-in-law, sons/daughters-in-law, other relatives, domestic employees, pensioners, workers, and other non-relatives, while Q12 combined with gender options allows identification of same-sex partners. Regarding multiple_household_criteria, document [M] explicitly defines a household based on shared dwelling, common budget for basic needs, and shared meals, and document [C] Chapter D Q1 specifies cohabitation and meal sharing. Regarding sub_units, the pointer variables linking each person to their mother, father, and spouse/partner enable the identification of secondary family nuclei or sub-units within the household. Regarding caregiving_relationships, Chapter K (Q4-Q6) asks if respondents provided care to children under 5, sick/disabled persons, or elderly persons in their own household or other households, but it does not identify specific person-to-person caregiving links (who specifically cares for whom at an individual member level).
